audit: cross-statement as-of factor panel (accruals) with a period-coherence filter and a strict-vs-naive ranking test

definition.accrual: (net profit - operating cash flow) / total assets, both flows as reported for the same period (YTD cumulative)
definition.cash_quality: operating cash flow / net profit, only where net profit > 0 (else NaN, disclosed not filled)
definition.coherence: income.period_end == cashflow.period_end == balance.period_end == the newest period public at the as-of date in all three faces
definition.degenerate: total assets <= 0 or missing; excluded from ranks and from the decile test, kept in the panel (r1107)
definition.naive: max period_end <= asof per face, availability ignored, then the same coherence filter
definition.peer_rank: accrual rank inside the period_end cohort, published because a month-end cross-section mixes annual and quarterly filers
definition.quarter_isolated_accrual: (single-period net profit - single-period operating cash flow) / total assets; Q1 is already one quarter, later periods subtract the previous report of the same fiscal year, else NaN (span not comparable)

columns: 经营性现金流-现金流量净额
